name: tracksmith
description: Outcome-first Kanban board for KiroCrew agent work

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tracksmith/shared && npm run build -w @tracksmith/server && npm run build -w @tracksmith/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @tracksmith/server" "npm run dev -w @tracksmith/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tracksmith/shared && npm run typecheck -w @tracksmith/server && npm run typecheck -w @tracksmith/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @tracksmith/shared && npm run test -w @tracksmith/server
